definitions.explanation: The part of the mind that influences thoughts and behavior without conscious awareness. Used in psychology, self-help, and everyday conversation about hidden motivations or feelings.

examples.japanese: {潜在|せんざい}{意識|いしき}に{働|はたら}きかける。
{潜在|せんざい}{意識|いしき}が{行動|こうどう}に{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
{自分|じぶん}の{潜在|せんざい}{意識|いしき}に{気|き}づくことが{自己|じこ}{成長|せいちょう}の{第一歩|だいいっぽ}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that becoming aware of your own subconscious is the first step toward personal growth.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in both academic psychology and popular self-help contexts. Often discussed in relation to habits, biases, and personal development.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {潜在|せんざい}{意識|いしき}に{働|はたら}きかける (to work on the subconscious)
- {潜在|せんざい}{意識|いしき}に{刷|す}り{込|こ}む (to imprint on the subconscious)
- {潜在|せんざい}{意識|いしき}レベルで (at a subconscious level)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {顕在|けんざい}{意識|いしき}: conscious awareness — the opposite, referring to thoughts one is actively aware of
- {無意識|むいしき}: unconscious — broader term that can mean both the psychological unconscious and doing something without thinking
